name: DL-Bench
description: DL-Bench is a benchmark dataset designed for function-level deep learning code generation. It categorizes DL problems by phases, tasks, and input data types, providing a comprehensive and challenging evaluation of LLMs' ability to generate DL-specific code across the full DL pipeline.
typical_sota_score: ~20–35% (agents generating correct bug-reproducing tests; lower than patch generation rates on SWE-bench)
reputation: A recent specialized benchmark for deep learning code generation that is useful for function-level evaluation, but it has not yet reached the broad adoption of older code benchmarks like HumanEval or MBPP.
notes: DL-Bench covers diverse DL phases and input types, is more challenging than existing benchmarks like DS-1000, and highlights distinct challenges in DL code generation.
